name: Lessons Learned (blameless postmortem)
summary: Review an incident or project without blame: what happened, impact, root causes, what went well, lessons and actions.
references: Google, Site Reliability Engineering, postmortem culture chapter (2016)
title_style: Plain factual titles, under 12 words; describe systems and events, not people.

sequence.purpose: Summary: what happened and the impact.
Action items with owners and dates.

pitfalls: Naming a person as the cause; look at systems and conditions.
Action items with no owner or date.
A timeline so detailed the lessons are lost.

example.topic: A fictional online store reviewing a checkout outage
outline: Orders failed for 47 minutes during the spring sale
About 1,200 orders retried later by customers
A config change skipped review under deadline pressure
Deadlines are when review matters most
Actions: config checks in CI, sale-week freeze
